Proposed solutions like **Advanced Search** and a **revamped Profile System** to streamline exploration and engagement, reinforcing Threads’ vision of being simple, human, and context-rich.

## Instagram Threads features

*Built with Alloy*

:alloy-logo: Used [ALLOY](https://alloy.app/) to create 2 Feature Prototypes for based on the teardown above

1. **Advanced Search:** Enables users to instantly find topics, people, and posts through a unified, intelligent search bar for seamless discovery. [Click to Access](https://alloy.app/gaurang-sultania/p/cdc9cf00-e18d-4f1f-bd98-7280d46f9473)
![](/assets/images/29eb3620-ce21-8040-9394-e52d6086fd1c.png)

1. **Revamped Profile System:** Allows creators to organize posts into folders, search their own content, and manage multiple threads effortlessly from one place. [Click to Access](https://alloy.app/gaurang-sultania/p/91ae5eec-5354-450f-9be1-593990b63acd)
